description: This file defines a Java interface for collateral reading operations within the Fineract platform. It includes method signatures for retrieving collateral data related to loans.

classes.name: CollateralReadPlatformService
classes.description: A Java interface providing methods to retrieve collateral information associated with loans.

methods.name: retrieveCollateralsForValidLoan
methods.description: Retrieves a list of collateral data for a given loan ID after validating the loan ID.

methods.name: retrieveCollaterals
methods.description: Retrieves a list of collateral data for a specified loan ID.

methods.name: retrieveCollateral
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific collateral associated with a loan.
